The '''raid on Hagamoor 3''' was a raid by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Imperial Hand]] [[Tahiri Veila]] on the [[Moon Maiden]] mine on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Hagamoor 3]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antemeridias]]. She was following [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was searching for the scientists who created the [[nanovirus]] that prevented him from visiting [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], in hopes that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] would lead her to [[Abeloth]].
